Theme Description: Observations about how the animals stand and move, contrasting bipedal and quadrupedal postures and noting digit configurations linked to locomotion. Emphasis is on stance depiction and functional foot/hand counts relevant to movement.

Subthemes.Subtheme Description: Mentions of two‑legged posture or depiction of dinosaurs moving primarily on the hind limbs.
References to four‑legged stance, including facultative quadrupedality and occasional rearing.
Counts and function of manual and pedal digits that inform locomotor capability and stance.

Theme Description: Descriptions of forelimb form and function, including arm robustness/length and the presence, absence, or exaggeration of claws or hooves. Focus is on manipulative structures and their variation.

Subthemes.Subtheme Description: Comments on relative arm thickness and length across specimens.
Presence, absence, and size of manual unguals and keratinized tips, including extreme claw morphologies.

Theme Description: Core body-shape descriptors emphasizing neck and head proportions and tail form/role. Highlights counterbalancing, taper, and relative size relationships.

Subthemes.Subtheme Description: Length and relative size/shape of necks and heads, including muzzle and facial proportions.
Tail length, thickness, tapering, and counterbalancing functions.

Theme Description: Head specializations used in recognition and feeding, including crests, beaks, and tooth/jaw types. Emphasizes diagnostic cranial traits.

Subthemes.Subtheme Description: Ornamental and feeding-related cranial structures used to distinguish taxa.
Tooth morphology and jaw visibility/arrangement indicating dietary strategies.

Theme Description: Notes on external color and countershading patterns in the reconstructions. Highlights green tones and yellowish underbellies.
Attempts to place specimens within clades and name specific taxa, including evolutionary/temporal framing. Integrates broad clade reasoning with specific identifications.

Subthemes.Subtheme Description: Identifications and inferences tied to theropods, including degree of derivation and candidate genera.
Identifications and phylogenetic context for basal sauropodomorphs/prosauropods.
Recognitions of hadrosaurids (esp. Lambeosaurus), their traits, size, and time period.
Broad clade/era framing and definitions used to situate taxa.

Theme Description: Statements about trophic strategy inferred from dentition and clade membership, spanning herbivory to omnivory/carnivory. Connects tooth form with diet categories.

Subthemes.Subtheme Description: Herbivorous habits and dental specializations supporting plant eating.
Predatory and mixed diets indicated by tooth shape and clade characterization.

Theme Description: Perceived overall massiveness and size, including references to the largest forms and heavy structures. Emphasizes robust, large-bodied impressions.

Subthemes.Subtheme Description: Notes of heavy bodies/tails and references to particularly large taxa.

Theme Description: Metacognitive remarks about difficulty identifying taxa and remembering names. Captures tentative guesses and memory load.
Codes that do not fit any other theme without overlap.
